title: Autumn Sunshine Cocktail
nutrition_tip: This golden, autumn sunshine cocktail recipe is made with maple syrup, Grand Mar…

ingredients.name: 1 fluid ounce brandy-based orange liqueur (such as Grand Marnier®)
1 clementine, juiced and peel cut into 1x1/4-inch strips

steps.text: Place ice cubes in a cocktail shaker; add bourbon, maple syrup, orange liqueur, clementine juice, and lemon juice. Cover and shake until the outside of the shaker has frosted, about 15 seconds. Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Light a match or lighter over cocktail; squeeze clementine peel strip near flame to ignite peel's oil. Rub peel on rim of glass; drop peel into cocktail.
